breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states that the midspan deflection for the uniform distributed load will be calculated using 'the standard formula for that case,' which refers to the proper UDL deflection formula (5wL^4/384EI). It does not mention replacing the distributed load with a resultant force at midspan, thereby correctly avoiding the erroneous approach described in the incomplete prompt.
